levels.description: Fund civic institutions and participatory programs across communities.

levels.title: Local Participation Fund
levels.description: Offer small grants to places with weak participation infrastructure.

levels.title: Civic Matching Compact
levels.description: Match locally raised civic funds with small public grants under open-access and transparency rules.

levels.title: Community Matching Credit
levels.description: Match community funds against open-access and disclosure tests.

levels.title: Voluntary Association Charter
levels.description: Favor voluntary associations and tax relief; wealthy districts may raise more matching money.

title: Regional renewal and population adaptation
scope: N/R; grant/parallel; LTS in US

levels.title: Regional Renewal Mission
levels.description: Rebuild transport, care and jobs in declining regions through long-lived public projects.

levels.title: Essential Services Fund
levels.description: Protect essential services and jobs in the most affected places.

levels.title: Renewal and Mobility Compact
levels.description: Keep essential services in declining regions while offering voluntary mobility and local business support.

levels.title: Local Enterprise Credit
levels.description: Combine basic local services with voluntary relocation support.

levels.title: Open Regional Opportunity Act
levels.description: Cut formation barriers and support mobility; those unable to move need a service floor.

title: Elections and ballot access
scope: N/R over their elections; national constitutional/legal floors remain; LTS in US for permissible procedures

levels.title: Universal Ballot Access Act
levels.description: Register eligible voters automatically and expand accessible polling widely.

levels.title: Polling Access Fund
levels.description: Fund polling access in communities with long travel or wait times.

levels.title: Secure Access Compact
levels.description: Expand practical ballot access alongside transparent rolls, reliable polling capacity, and independent checks.

levels.title: Reliable Polling Reform
levels.description: Pair convenient voting with transparent rolls and independent checks.

levels.title: Transparent Elections Charter
levels.description: Standardize secure polling capacity; tight verification must not block eligible voters.

title: Public records and transparency
scope: N/R for each government's records; LTS in US for extra state transparency programs

levels.title: Open Government Guarantee
levels.description: Require broad proactive disclosure and staff response offices to clear records backlogs.

levels.title: Records Access Fund
levels.description: Fund access to the records most often requested by the public.

levels.title: Open Records Compact
levels.description: Guarantee timely access to core records and publish machine-readable data with narrow, reviewable exemptions.

levels.title: Usable Data Reform
levels.description: Publish machine-readable records and enforce measured response deadlines.

levels.title: Rapid Disclosure Charter
levels.description: Make rapid disclosure the default while retaining narrow, reviewable exemptions.

title: Ethics, audit and procurement
scope: N/R; parallel

levels.title: Independent Integrity Commission
levels.description: Empower independent inspectors to investigate misconduct and enforce disclosure.

levels.title: Public Inspectors Fund
levels.description: Target audit staff at high-risk contracts and conflicts of interest.

levels.title: Audit and Purchasing Compact
levels.description: Maintain independent ethics review while making procurement competitive and recording clear digital audit trails.

levels.title: Competitive Procurement Code
levels.description: Require competitive bids and independent review for major purchasing.

levels.title: Automated Integrity Charter
levels.description: Automate audit trails broadly; a human authority must still investigate anomalies.

title: Civil liberties and privacy
scope: N rights floor plus R protections; LTS in US only for supplementary rulemaking

levels.title: Civil Liberties Guarantee
levels.description: Establish strong privacy and due-process limits with independent enforcement.

levels.title: Independent Rights Review
levels.description: Fund oversight and remedies for the most intrusive state powers.

levels.title: Warrants and Remedies Compact
levels.description: Define narrow lawful powers, require reviewable warrants, and provide fast independent remedies for violations.

levels.title: Judicial Safeguards Reform
levels.description: Require reviewable warrants and judicial remedies for specified searches.

levels.title: Clear Powers Charter
levels.description: Clarify enforcement powers and fast remedies, guarding against overly broad exceptions.

title: Press and information integrity
scope: N/R only where competent; independent regulator/press protections; no ministerial editorial control

levels.title: Independent Media Commons
levels.description: Support independent public-interest journalism and literacy without directing editorial decisions.

levels.title: Media Literacy Fund
levels.description: Fund nonpartisan media literacy for underserved audiences.

levels.title: Free Press Integrity Compact
levels.description: Support nonpartisan media literacy and require ownership disclosure while protecting editorial independence.

levels.title: Ownership Disclosure Reform
levels.description: Require clear ownership disclosure and narrow fraud controls.

levels.title: Open Platform Charter
levels.description: Open platform competition and tightly defined fraud remedies; protect lawful dissent.

title: Armed-forces readiness
scope: N only; no "leave it" or regional military duplicate

levels.title: National Readiness Renewal Act
levels.description: Rebuild personnel, maintenance and logistics capacity across the forces over several years.

levels.title: Retention and Maintenance Fund
levels.description: Target retention and repairs at the least available units.

levels.title: Readiness and Reform Compact
levels.description: Fund critical personnel and equipment upkeep while testing procurement competition and reserve training against readiness.

levels.title: Reserve Procurement Reform
levels.description: Compete procurement and expand reserve training against measurable readiness tests.

levels.title: Lean Force Modernization Act
levels.description: Restructure widely for lower unit cost; transition gaps can reduce near-term availability.
